test_title: PYST 41: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

After a tiring day, the workers decided to ____________ to restore their energy

options.text: put a spoke in the wheel

solution:
The correct answer is- **"hit the sack"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options,** "hit the sack" **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• **Hit the sack:** This idiom is used to mean-** **"to go to bed in order to sleep" .
 
 
• **Example: **The day was so tiring that I **hit the sack** as soon I reached the home.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 4)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too.

 
• **Have an axe to grind:** A selfish aim or motive

 
 
• **Example: **I have **no axe to grind** towards him because he seems like a kind guy.
 
 
 
• **Put a spoke in the wheel:** to make it challenging for someone to complete anything they had planned to do.
 
 
• **Example: **She simply couldn't help but **put a spoke in your wheel **out of jealousy over your friendship with James.
 
 
 
• **Bring to book : **to reprimand someone and demand an explanation for their actions.
 
 
• **Example: **He will be **brought to books** for his misdeeds someday.
